csv_project_name: Consultant for Nibley- 1200 West Park Design
csv_scope_of_work: Nibley City desires to retain the services of a professional consulting firm for the purpose of completing concepts and design for the 1200 West Park located at approximately 3400 South at 1200 West (hereafter City Park). The selected consultant will provide several concept plans for the 1200 West Park, both the east and west sections and Phase 1 design plans and bidding documents for construction. Final concepts and design will be based on the Nibley City Parks, Recreation, and Open Space Master Plan (Parks Master Plan), and input provided by City Council, staff, and the Parks and Recreation Advisory Committee.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
